notes:
Account snapshot: Cobalt Folio manages a large broadcast/transcript archive used by newsrooms and rights teams. Primary pain: search relevance on very long docs and unpredictable cost from naive reranking. Wants a production RAG solution for journalist workflows and internal compliance search.

Corpus & scale: ingestion plan ~15M unique documents but after chunking expect ~50M embedding vectors. Average raw doc 12k-25k words; many 100k+ char exhibits. Index growth 20% qtr.

Latency & cost targets (customer):
- Interactive search latency target: 250-400ms for initial retrieval (bi-encoder), total gated search <900ms including reranker for top-10.
- Cost sensitivity: bench target ~$0.003 - $0.01 per query (incl. reranking amortized); will buy Dedicated if unit economics predictable.

Chunking strategy discussions:
- Current hypothesis: use variable chunk windows (1k-2k tokens) for prose, larger 3k tokens for transcripts; 20-30% overlap to preserve context.
- Need smart chunk boundaries (sentence/section aware) rather than fixed byte splits to improve reranker signal.
- Evaluating hybrid: smaller chunks for recall + stitched summarization to present snippet.

Retrieval + reranking design notes:
- Two-stage retrieval: dense bi-encoder ANN index (faiss/HNSW) for recall -> lightweight re-ranker (distilled cross-encoder) for top-10 rescore.
- Experiment plan: retriever recall @100 vs. reranker gain @10. Budget: keep cross-encoder calls <= top-20 to control cost.
- Consider Redwood Optimize: automatic top-k recommendations, batching for rerank calls, and cache reuse for repeated queries.

POC configuration & metrics:
- Planned POC: Dedicated 4xA100 equivalent, shard index across 3 nodes, 50M vectors. Measure: p95 retrieval latency, rerank latency, tokens/sec, cost-per-query.
- Success criteria: p95 end-to-end <900ms, MAP@10 improvement +15% over current baseline, cost <= $0.01/query at scale.

Security/compliance:
- Must support customer-managed KMS, audit logs for query traces, SSO (SAML) for console access, and EU data residency for EU-subset. On-prem option requested for final deployment.

Stated quotes from calls: "We don't mind a small rerank step, but it has to be predictable — lawyers hate flakiness." — Head of Search (Cobalt Folio).

- Schedule on-prem feasibility call w/ Infra (Marco) if security questionnaire flags remain.
